glosses: To cooperate or yield when forced or pressured to do so.

examples.text: The man is a ruffian. I won't knuckle under to him!

glosses: To kneel and bow low enough to touch one’s forehead to the ground.

examples.text: When the weather turned cold, the tears that he shed would become frozen like veins; the blood on his forehead from kowtowing would also freeze and would not drip.

glosses: To grovel, act in a very submissive manner; to show obeisance to (someone or something) in such a manner; to bow.
